# Incident Report: S-TUN-003 Alarms Investigation

- **Classification:** no_impact
- **Root cause:** no_impact at `S-TUN-003`
- **Confidence:** high (Direct alarm evidence showing self-clearing minor and warning alerts combined with completely normal KPI series; change log and external events were NOT CHECKED.)
- **Impact:** 2026-09-20 20:53 to 2026-09-20 21:51
- **Cause time:** 2026-09-20 20:53
- **Affected:** S-TUN-003

## Summary

Transient environmental or hardware warnings (VSWR_HIGH and TEMP_HIGH) raised on S-TUN-003 with zero service impact.

No service impact observed; all 23 alarms self-cleared within 10 minutes and KPI metrics remained normal.

## Timeline

- 2026-09-20 18:00: Monitoring window started for site S-TUN-003. [T3, T4]
- 2026-09-20 20:53: First minor VSWR_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-003. [T3, ALM-000430]
- 2026-09-20 20:57: First warning TEMP_HIGH alarm raised on S-TUN-003. [T3, ALM-000431]
- 2026-09-20 21:42: Final TEMP_HIGH warning alarm cleared. [T3, ALM-000431]
- 2026-09-20 21:51: Final VSWR_HIGH minor alarm cleared, ending the alarm burst. [T3, ALM-000430]

## Evidence

- Site S-TUN-003 raised 23 self-clearing, low-severity alarms consisting of 11 minor VSWR_HIGH and 12 warning TEMP_HIGH occurrences between 2026-09-20 20:53 and 2026-09-21 08:26. [T3, ALM-000430, ALM-000431]
- All KPI series including availability, drop rate, RRC success rate, and DL traffic volume remained completely normal with zero deviation from baseline. [T4]
- No anomaly detector alerts or scheduled maintenance were recorded for S-TUN-003 and its relatives during the window. [T1, T5]

## Hypotheses

1. **no_impact** at S-TUN-003: confirmed. Alarms were purely self-clearing minor/warning events and KPIs showed zero degradation or deviation from baseline. [T3, T4]

## Recommended actions

- Continue standard monitoring of S-TUN-003.
- Inspect physical RF and environmental ventilation if alarms recur frequently.
